title: Gift Of Spectral Whispers

fields.label: Function
fields.value: When opened, it becomes a decorative Ghostified Maui

body:
Overview:

The Gift of Spectral Whispers was a gift sold at the Monstrous Manor between 10/4/2024-11/4/2024. It was sold for $35,000. When opened, you can get Ghostai.

Appearance

It's appearance is a white and gray blended colored box with a gray bow keeping the box shut.
